timeline.summary: Rashi Peripherals announced postal ballot voting results approving the appointment of Rajesh Goenka as CEO and Dr. Indumati Gopinathan as an Independent Director.
Rashi Peripherals submitted its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, reporting a consolidated revenue of ₹15,827 Cr and PAT of ₹282 Cr.
Rashi Peripherals reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,489 Cr, up 51% YoY, and PAT of ₹87 Cr.
On 23 May 2026, Rashi Peripherals received a customs adjudication order dropping the entire ₹3.53 Cr demand under SCN 808/2025-26 for FY24-25.
Mumbai Customs confirmed an ₹8.02 Cr customs duty and penalty demand against Rashi Peripherals, which will be appealed before CESTAT.
Rashi Peripherals received an NSE communication on October 19, 2026, rejecting its waiver application and levying a fine of ₹0.02 crore for Regulation 17(1A) non-compliance.
